H0: Outcome groups have equal population means for BMI.
H1: Outcome groups have unequal population means for BMI.
why_selected: Continuous measurement; unequal variances and sample sizes allowed.
conclusion: Do not reject H0 at unadjusted alpha=0.05: insufficient evidence of a mean difference.

H0: Outcome groups have the same distribution of BMI.
H1: Outcome groups differ in the distribution of BMI.
why_selected: Rank-based check of skewed values/outliers; not automatically a median test.
conclusion: Do not reject H0 at unadjusted alpha=0.05: insufficient evidence of a distribution/rank difference.
